name: Sound Effects
description: A library of sound effects built from the synthesized kit, with no samples at all: interface clicks and chimes, arcade coins and lasers, a starship bridge, a haunted house, cartoon gags, a thunderstorm, an open-plan office, footsteps walking around you, alarms and sirens, and a trailer-style riser and impact. Each sketch loops a small set of effects, one per bar or layered as a scene, and the comments explain how each sound is made, so you can lift any line into your own sketch.
author: Claude, for Tartlet

sketches.name: Interface Kit
sketches.description: Five interface sounds, one per bar: a soft click, a toggle, a notification chime, a success arpeggio and an error buzz.

sketches.name: Arcade Cabinet
sketches.description: Six classic game sounds, one per bar: a coin, a jump, a laser burst, a power-up run, an explosion and the game-over tune.

sketches.name: Starship Bridge
sketches.description: A sci-fi bridge: engines humming below and a computer thinking aloud, while a door hisses open, the teleporter charges, a confirmation chirps and red alert sounds, one bar each.
sketches.source:
setcpm(80/4)

// The bridge: engines humming somewhere below, and the computer thinking aloud
hum: s("engine").slow(8).lpf(300).elevation(-30).distance(3).gain(.12)
computer: n(irand(8).segment(8)).scale("C:major pentatonic").transpose(24)
  .degradeBy(.5).seed("bridge").s("sine").decay(.05).sustain(0).pan(rand).gain(.08)

// Bar 1 of every four: the door hisses open on your left, filtered pink noise with a fast decay
door: s("<pink ~ ~ ~>").hpf(1500).lpf(6000).attack(.05).decay(.5).sustain(0)
  .azimuth(-50).distance(1.5).gain(.14)

// Bar 2: the teleporter charges, a rising sine sweep ring-modulated into a shimmer
teleport: freq(saw.range(300, 3000).segment(32)).s("sine").mono(1).glide(.03)
  .ringmod(80).ringmix(.4).mask("<0 1 0 0>").sustain(1).release(.02).gain(.06)
sparks: s("white*16?0.6").hpf(6000).decay(.03).sustain(0).mask("<0 1 0 0>")
  .azimuth(rand.range(-90, 90)).seed("sparks").gain(.06)

// Bar 3: a confirmation chirp
confirm: note("<~ ~ [c6 g6 ~ ~] ~>").s("sine").fm(1.5).fmh(2).decay(.15).sustain(0).gain(.1)

// Bar 4: red alert, two notes alternating like a klaxon
alert: note("<~ ~ ~ [a4 e5]*4>").s("square").pw(.5).lpf(1800)
  .decay(.1).sustain(.6).release(.05).gain(.07)

sketches.name: Haunted House
sketches.description: Headphones on: wind outside, a door creaking open on your left, footsteps in the room above, thunder, a heartbeat in the middle of your head and whispers circling you.

sketches.name: Cartoon Toolbox
sketches.description: Five cartoon gags, one per bar: a slide whistle, a spring boing, a bonk on the head with birdies, a run of zips and a clown horn.

sketches.name: Storm Kit
sketches.description: A thunderstorm in four bars: rain that swells and eases, wind, a sharp lightning crack followed by a rolling rumble, and drips from the gutter all around you.

sketches.name: Open-Plan Office
sketches.description: An office around you: your own keyboard and mouse, a phone ringing across the room, a printer behind you, an elevator ding, air conditioning and muffled chatter.

sketches.name: Footsteps Around You
sketches.description: Headphones on: someone walks a slow circle around your head, two bars each on wood, gravel and through puddles, then up a flight of stairs.

sketches.name: Alarms and Sirens
sketches.description: Two bars each: a siren passing from left to right, a smoke detector, an alarm clock, then a foghorn far out at sea and a car alarm whooping.
sketches.source:
setcpm(60/4)

// Bars 1-2: a siren, a sine gliding up and down, passing from your left to your right
siren: freq(sine.range(600, 1200).slow(2).segment(16)).s("sine").mono(1).glide(.12)
  .azimuth(saw.range(-90, 90).slow(2)).distance(4).posglide(.3)
  .mask("<1 1 0 0 0 0 0 0>").sustain(1).release(.05).gain(.06)

// Bars 3-4: a smoke detector, three piercing beeps
smoke: note("[f7 f7 f7 ~]").s("square").pw(.5).decay(.15).sustain(.6).release(.02)
  .mask("<0 0 1 1 0 0 0 0>").gain(.03)

// Bars 5-6: an alarm clock, beeping in bursts of four
clock: note("[a5 a5 a5 a5 ~ ~ ~ ~]*2").s("square").pw(.5).decay(.05).sustain(.5).release(.02)
  .mask("<0 0 0 0 1 1 0 0>").gain(.05)

// Bar 7: a foghorn far out at sea
foghorn: note("<~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ a1 ~>").s("sawtooth").vowel("o").lpf(500)
  .attack(.3).sustain(1).release(1).distance(10).space("outdoor").gain(.3)

// Bar 8: a car alarm, a fast rising whoop
caralarm: freq(saw.range(800, 1600).fast(4).segment(32)).s("square").pw(.4).mono(1).glide(.02)
  .lpf(3000).mask("<0 0 0 0 0 0 0 1>").sustain(1).release(.02).azimuth(40).distance(5).gain(.05)

sketches.name: Trailer Hit
sketches.description: The movie trailer move: three bars of a rising noise sweep and an accelerating clock, a reverse whoosh into the downbeat, then a huge impact with a sub drop and a brass tail.
